_doc: Warrior subclasses (docs/plans/warrior-subclasses.md). The chosen subclass is the PC string attribute "subclass", wiped at remort. Skill bans and gains are <subclasses> nodes in each skill XML (node named after the subclass: <level> gives the skill, <level>-1 bans it), read by C++ GenericSkill. This file holds what Fenia reads (dreamland_fenia utils/subclass): the gates of the choice (profession, level, min/max race size from .tables.size_table, minimum trainable stat caps) and the weapon rules of the subclass skills (weapon_classes = any weapon of these classes; an off-hand weapon must fit too). A subclass missing here gives no gains through its weapon rules, and its skills refuse with weapon_refusal.

bladestorm._doc: cooldown in seconds between two spins; moves cost = skill level / move_div, at least 1.

weapon_refusal.en: This takes a sword or an axe in hand, and nothing else.
weapon_refusal.ru: Для этого нужен меч или топор в руках, и ничего другого.
weapon_refusal.ua: Для цього потрібен меч або сокира в руках, і нічого іншого.
